incidents.title: Database connection pool exhaustion
incidents.human_explanation: The logs show 9 occurrence(s) of this problem affecting payments-service between 2026-07-13T08:02:01.230Z and 2026-07-13T08:02:31.996Z. The recurring message looks like: "[payments-service] HikariPool-1 - Connection is not available, request timed out after 30001ms (pool exhausted, 50/50 ac". This pattern usually means the service could not do its normal work and requests started failing. The cited lines below are the concrete evidence.
possible_solutions: Increase the database connection pool size (or lower per-request hold time) and restart the affected service.
Check the database server for slow queries or locks that are holding connections open.
Add a circuit breaker / timeout so dependent services fail fast instead of queueing.

incidents.title: Downstream timeouts
incidents.human_explanation: The logs show 5 occurrence(s) of this problem affecting api-gateway, checkout-service between 2026-07-13T08:02:18.771Z and 2026-07-13T08:02:25.671Z. The recurring message looks like: "[checkout-service] Timeout calling payments-service POST /internal/charge after 30000ms". This pattern usually means the service could not do its normal work and requests started failing. The cited lines below are the concrete evidence.
possible_solutions: Identify the slow dependency and confirm it is healthy before restarting callers.
Raise or tune the client timeout only after the root bottleneck is fixed.
